description: Offline learning-plane comparison (#140). Fixture tasks with deterministic outcomes per (harness, model), see meshloop.toml: t1-any verifies any tree, t1-file and t2-file need the file a worker writes, t1-never fails for every worker. warmup=false tasks are measured only. Changing a task, a verify command, a tier or a configuration changes the recorded cell fold (cell-fold.json), which must then be recorded again with the real cell.
